'''Strix''' was a [[human]] [[warlord]]<ref name="Hayna DB">{{Databank|hayna|Hayna}}</ref> and the [[general]] the [[Troik]] forces.<ref name="Cant Say" /> He was regarded by his clan as the one true ruler of [[At Achrann]]. Strix's [[Gender|daughter]], [[Hayna]], was already a fierce and capable warrior at a young age.<ref name="DB" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
General Strix first appeared in "[[Can't Say I Remember No At Attin]]," the fourth episode of ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]''. He was portrayed by [[Mathieu Kassovitz]].<ref name="Cant Say" />
